rationale: Post-migration SEO invisibility is a real and high-stakes pain, but the evidence base is too thin to meet the pass bar: the primary signal is a single Stack Exchange question with no corroborating pain quotes, no willingness-to-pay signal beyond the general existence of SEO tools like Ahrefs/Semrush, and no competitor charging specifically for domain-migration diagnostics. The episodic nature of domain migrations (once per site, not recurring) further limits TAM depth. Marking inconclusive rather than dead-fail — re-queue with broader search for migration-specific Reddit/IH threads.
